field.name: idCountry
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_COUNTRY_LABEL
field.query: select ct.idCountry as value, ct.country as idCountry from #__elg_country c inner join #__elg_country_translation ct on c.id = ct.idCountry and {language} order by c.ordering, ct.country
